name: Lottis Creek Campground
evidence: Official as-built survey on rec.gov (116389_F389.pdf sheet 1, Park Cone Loop) draws Lottis Creek ~13-20 m from pads of RV sites 8, 9, 10 (32-66 ft, FCFS nightly), scattered trees only; georeferenced to z19 l_d.jpg, dark channel matches (~14-23 m). Creek ~3-5 m wide. No per-site photos exist. Baldy and Union Park loops inland.

name: Mavreeso Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site notices: 01 '20ft to River', 05 25 ft, 06 30 ft, 10E/13/14/15/16E/17E/18E 35 ft; RV lengths 30-60 ft. Satellite mv_a/b/d/e shows open gravel bank at Loops A and B; photos mvp_0/1 confirm (01, 13). West Dolores measured ~10-20 m wide at the sites, under the ~30 m river size, so creekside.

name: Marshall Park Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site coords on z19 mp_a/mp_b: RV sites 005, 006, 010, 011, 013 (40-56 ft) ~15-25 m from Rio Grande bank across open ground; photos mpp_0/1 show river beside 005, 006, 010, 013 (007 is tent-only, not counted). Channel measured ~31-35 m at the sites (21 m only at a reach upstream). Confirmed.

name: Mill Creek Campground (Lake Fork Gunnison)
evidence: rec.gov tags 15, 16, 20 'Riverfront', but z19 mc_a/mc_b with site dots puts them ~38-65 m from the ~10-15 m channel through continuous spruce/willow; meadow sites 11-13 ~60+ m behind willow. All site photos (mcp_0-2) show no water. Imagery contradicts the tag; dots could err a little, hence low.

name: Mix Lake Campground
evidence: Open-Meteo sightline profiles (15 pairs) from all loops on z19 mx_d/mx_e to Mix Lake: all blocked by a ridge at 3081-3115 m on coarse DEM (loops 3044-3079 m, lake 3065-3075 m), lake 270-600 m away. FS 'overlooks Mix Lake' is prose; the on-site overlook is not a site value. Conejos ~150 m S past road. Below Platoro dam. No site photos found.

name: Molly Brown Campground
evidence: Official rec.gov site photos mbp_0 show Turquoise Lake through open lodgepole from RV sites 006 (30 ft), 010 (30 ft), 012 (35 ft); 008 also but capped 20 ft. z18 mb_a dots: west row ~60-90 m from full-pool edge, no apron, so lakeview not lakefront. All 45 site photos viewed; others show at most a bright gap in the trees.

name: Monument Lake Resort
evidence: Official FareHarbor maps put 'Tent or RV' 15, 16 (NE), 39, 40 (NW), 76-79 (W) at the shore, no road between. z19 mo_b/f/g, pads matched by map layout: NE open apron ~10-20 m from water, NW bank and W pads ~20-25 m (shrub strip, gap by 78). Lake side of dam. Hookup sites 1-19, 50-75 lie south of it: no lake value. No length cap posted on these sites.

name: Mosca Campground
evidence: rec.gov has one FCFS record, no site list, photos or map. Summer USGS frame ms_usgs plus Esri ms_a/b/c (winter): pins ~130 m S of full-pool shore in forest with clearings; only the boat-ramp lot reaches SW shore; no RV pad locatable there. FS 'on the banks' is prose. Default down; a site map could change this.
